summary: Frontend-only test of MemberSheet 'Permisos en el grupo' role picker feature (item 3 of plan). Tested on mobile viewport (390x844) logged in as ana.demo@sentinelfamily.app against real 'Grupo 1' fixture (Ana=owner, Luis=temporary_guest/expired). All acceptance criteria verified and passed.
critical_code_review_comments: sheets.tsx MemberSheet/RoleRow code is clean and correctly gated: canEditRole = canManage && !!onChangeRole && member.role !== 'owner' (owner protection at line 90).

Both group/[id].tsx and onboarding/group.tsx correctly derive 'selected'/'selectedMember' reactively via .find() against the live query data (group.members / list groups) each render, not a stale snapshot - satisfies the 'live data without close/reopen' requirement.
RoleRow correctly disables the Pressable when active||loading (line 140 sheets.tsx), preventing redundant API calls when tapping the already-active role.

success_rate.backend: N/A - not tested (per request, frontend only)

seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up one throwaway pending invite 'TEST_Regression' in Grupo 1 to verify resend/cancel buttons alongside role picker; cancelled it immediately after verification (member fully removed, not left in DB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified test matrix: (1) Role picker renders with all 5 roles (admin/adult_responsible/adult_member/protected_minor/temporary_guest) and Spanish labels/sub-labels exactly as specified, reachable from BOTH group/[id].tsx (member-row-{id} tap) and onboarding/group.tsx (orbital-member-{id} tap). (2) Tapping a non-active role fires PATCH /groups/{gid}/members/{mid}/role, shows success toast, sheet stays open, checkmark moves to new role immediately (no close/reopen needed) - confirmed reactively on both screens. (3) Tapping the already-active role fires ZERO network requests (verified via request listener) due to `r !== member.role` guard + Pressable disabled={active}. (4) Persistence confirmed via full page reload showing the new role in the member row/list. (5) Owner (Ana) never shows the role picker or remove button when viewing her own MemberSheet - confirmed via DOM query (no 'Permisos en el grupo' text found). (6) Regression: pending member (fresh TEST_ invite) correctly shows resend+cancel buttons together with the role picker (all onboarding features co-exist correctly); non-pending non-owner member (Luis, status=expired) correctly shows only the remove button (no resend/cancel, matching pending-only gating). Fixture state fully restored at the end: Luis is back to role=temporary_guest/status=expired exactly as documented in test_credentials.md, and the throwaway TEST_Regression invite was cancelled/removed. No bugs found in this feature.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs found. Note for future testers: during testing I briefly suspected a role-inconsistency between the /api/groups list endpoint and /api/groups/{id} detail endpoint across two separate script executions, but a controlled follow-up test (set role via direct API call, then fresh-load onboarding/group screen) proved both endpoints and both UI entry points are fully consistent and reactive - the earlier confusion was due to misreading which of two near-identical screenshots corresponded to before/after a click, not an actual defect.
